name: FFS_MESSAGE_STEP_CONDITION
description: Contains conditions intended to check if a message is to be generated on particular scenario step.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the message step blocking condition.

columns.name: STEP_ID
columns.description: Link to the record in FFS_MESSAGE_STEP->STEP_ID.

columns.name: FIELD
columns.description: Name of a standard field this condition is to be applied to. Or, the 'property' string is used for the case when this condition is related to a custom property.

columns.name: ADDRESS_PROPERTY_ID
columns.description: Reference to the unique property ID -> FFS_PROPERTY_DESC -> PROPERTY_ID.

columns.name: CONDITION
columns.description: Operation. Values: 'in', 'not_in', 'is_null', 'is_not_null', '>', '<', '>=', '<=', 'starts_with', 'dstart_with'.

columns.name: COMPARISON
columns.description: The function applied to the value of the blocking condition.

columns.name: RESULT
columns.description: The message status which is set for the message if it is blocked by the condition.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: The desription which is set for the message if it is blocked by the condition.

columns.name: SORT_ORDER
columns.description: The integer value which is used to order the blocking conditions.

columns.name: OPTIONS
columns.description: Boolean flags that control the time of blocking condition being verified - message creation, sending, creation and sending.

columns.name: VALUE
columns.description: The value which is used in the blocking condition.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the record is logically deleted (Y - soft deleted, N or NULL - active).
